help.name: /name <new>     change your name
help.codes: codes: ko en zh ja vi fr de es ru id pt
help.enter: Enter           send or run a command
usage.name: usage: /name <new name>   (or press Ctrl+N)
peers.none_hint: no peers yet. Start herdr-talk on another PC on the same network.
status.line: herdr-talk  |  {name}  |  peers: {peers}  |  Ctrl+N: rename   /help   Ctrl+C: quit
start.hello: herdr-talk: you are '{name}' (TCP port {port}). Type /help for commands.
open.no_pane: herdr-talk open: run this from a herdr pane (HERDR_PANE_ID is not set).
usage.trust: usage: /trust <code>   (the code shown on the other PC)
trust.done: trusted {name}. Messages to them are now encrypted.
trust.none: no unverified peer has the code {code}
trust.save_failed: trusted for this session only, could not save: {error}
peer.unverified: not sent to {name}: not verified yet. Compare codes, then /trust
peer.plain_off: not sent to {name}: they do not encrypt, and plain text is off
peer.fingerprint: {name} needs verifying. Code: {code}. Compare it on both screens, then type /trust {code}
peer.key_changed: {name} at {ip} has a new key. Not trusted, nothing sent. Use /trust only if you know why
trust.ambiguous: several different keys match code {code}. Not trusted: compare the codes again
